1) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, wherein the composition is not limited to use in treating chronic skin conditions but also includes preventative applications for maintaining skin health. (Currently amended)

3) Composition according to one or more of the Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight, wherein said amount is suitable for both treatment and prophylaxis. (Currently amended)

5) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient 5 ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, and wherein the function of ectoine includes not only treatment but also prevention of skin-related conditions. (Currently amended)

7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition suitable for both treatment and prophylaxis of skin conditions, including those associated with keratinisation defects. (Currently amended)

9) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development, wherein the use is further specified for both improving existing hair conditions and preventing future hair and scalp issues. (Currently amended)

10) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation, or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair, including prophylactic measures against skin deterioration. (Currently amended)

12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening, wherein said use is applicable for both treatment and prophylactic purposes. (Currently amended)

14) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin, wherein the term “prophylaxis” is intended to cover measures to maintain skin quality and prevent the worsening of existing conditions. (Currently amended)
